budget.title: AI budget
budget.pause: ⚠️ {title} {pct} used · ${spent} of ${budget} this month ({pct}, {source}) What is paused Auto-kits and extra scoring, until the limit resets on the 1st. Mail, insights and interview reviews keep running. Next step To resume now, raise the limit in the Anthropic console and JOBADABRA_MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD.
budget.warn: 💸 {title} {pct} used · ${spent} of ${budget} this month ({pct}, {source}) What happens next At 90% the optional AI steps pause so the essentials keep running.

apply.notFound: ⚠️ Job not found No job with code {code}. It may have closed; add it in {where} manually.
apply.applied: ✅ Marked applied {title} {next} It won't appear in digests again. Track the stage in {link}.
apply.saved: ⭐ Saved {title} {next} It stays in digests with a star; /saved lists your saved jobs.
apply.dismissed: ❌ Dismissed {title} {next} It won't appear again, and helps tune the scores.

interview.truncated: The transcript was very long; only the first part was analysed.
interview.linkApplication: Link it to its application in Notion (Application column).
interview.differs: {label}: the call said “{value}”, the job says “{current}” (not changed)
limit.api.interview: ⚠️ The Anthropic API spend limit is reached, so the interview review is paused. Raise the limit in the Anthropic console (Settings → Limits); otherwise it resumes when the limit resets.{retry}
limit.api.insight: ⚠️ The Anthropic API spend limit is reached, so the insight report is paused. Raise the limit in the Anthropic console (Settings → Limits); otherwise it resumes when the limit resets.{retry}
limit.api.weekly: ⚠️ The Anthropic API spend limit is reached, so the weekly report is paused. Raise the limit in the Anthropic console (Settings → Limits); otherwise it resumes when the limit resets.{retry}
limit.retryInterview: Your transcript is kept: after raising it, send it again, or re-run this run.
receipt.walled: ℹ️ That page showed a sign-in page instead of the posting. For the fit score and facts, send me a screenshot of the job posting too, or add it in the app with its text.
receipt.noPosting: ℹ️ The posting text could not be read, so it is not scored yet. Add its text (the app asks for it) for the fit score and facts.

inbox.agreementCheck: whether you agreed to talk to the recruiter (not moved to Screening)
inbox.impossibleDate: call date {date} impossible for this message: not saved

inbox.alreadyQuiet: ℹ️ Already tracked: {label} ({stage}). Nothing new to log.
